method: Read-only numpy analysis of sampled positions/quaternions. Central finite differences, quaternion sign continuity and shortest-path angular velocity. Report median/p95/p99/max separately. Authored-core derivatives exclude two samples at capture edges and blendWeight<.99. No curve smoothing, interpolation, source changes or gameplay edits.
limitations: A single cycle cannot establish recurring cadence as confidently as two or more. Derivative noise scales with sample spacing; compare reports at the same sampling rate. No universal acceleration limit distinguishes intentional impact from an error. Loop windows are candidates for review and do not approve automated trimming.
